Are you ready to unlock higher dimensions of consciousness and spiritual power ? The Chakra Hawan at Ashaeiynn is a sacred process that enhances your prayer strength, aura energy, and spiritual vision . What is Chakra Hawan?

Chakra Hawan is a highly advanced spiritual ritual that works on different dimensions within each chakra. Each chakra corresponds to a particular dimension, and during this Hawan, these dimensions are activated, leading to an increased ability to manifest, meditate, and enhance spiritual vision .
This process allows you to ascend through different spiritual dimensions, ranging from 5-50 to 50-500 dimensions , based on your mantra chanting ability and energy absorption capacity .
Why is Chakra Hawan Important?
Unlock Higher Dimensions: Each chakra activation opens new dimensions of spiritual consciousness .
Enhance Prayer Power: Increased ability to connect with divine energies and strengthen your spiritual presence.
Expand Your Spiritual Vision: Experience a heightened third-eye activation and deeper spiritual insights.
Improve Energy Absorption: Your ability to absorb and channel divine energy enhances dramatically.
Prerequisite for Higher Practices: This Hawan is performed only after Aura Shielding Hawan , ensuring your energy field is fully purified before ascending to higher levels.
How Does Chakra Hawan Work?
Prerequisite: You must have completed Aura Shielding Hawan and waited for 14 days .
Dimension Activation: Each chakra activation aligns with a particular set of dimensions , unlocking higher spiritual awareness.
Personalized Energy Work: The level of dimensional expansion depends on how much mantra chanting and spiritual practice you have done before.
Online Participation: This Hawan is conducted via Zoom , where your name and sankalp are included in the sacred offerings.
Gradual Energy Ascension: Over time, your energy levels, prayer strength, and spiritual vision expand significantly.
Who Should Participate?
Those who have already completed Aura Shielding Hawan .
Spiritual seekers looking to activate their chakras and unlock higher dimensions .
Individuals wanting to increase their prayer power and third-eye vision .
Those seeking a stronger connection with divine energies .
